answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital assets rather than node count, creating a vast canyon between honest participants and malicious actors. By requiring bonded collateral, the network forces an attacker to purchase an island of liquidity to gain control, a cost prohibitive enough to disperse any nebula of fake identities. This financial barrier ensures that economic weight, not quantity, dictates consensus outcomes.
